title: orchis pallens subsp. provincialis
intro: Orchis pallens subsp. provincialis, commonly known as the Provençal orchid, is a subspecies of the Orchis pallens, a type of terrestrial orchid native to southern Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis pallens subsp. provincialis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
